CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified contents found.

COD.rationale: Content (red) is identified at p0/current/n3, its organization/presentation is given by the same red coordinate set, and an origin/status field is attached to p0/current/n3.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition is linked to the identified content's presentation/access in the text.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify colors (red/blue) bound to coordinate sets at named referents and times.

D.rationale: Origins/metadata are attached to named contents, separating identification (color at coordinates) from status/origin information.

O.rationale: The report states how contents are presented across named nodes and candidate structures using coordinate sets and explicit candidate/current distinctions.
